statusGroups.reason: The managed standalone graph follows the pinned 4.7.2 directed-segment and A-star implementation: endpoint weights, custom typed cost/heuristic/filter hooks, partial closest-reached path, lowest-ID nearest tie, swap-last ID/neighbor order and power-of-two capacity. AStar2DTests covers the four-point source fixture, weighted rerouting, disabled/one-way edges, segment queries, callbacks/re-entry/lifetime failures, reservation thresholds and a 1024-point path. Finite-input and typed exception validation are the ADR 0052 boundary; SDL, physics-server and platform hardware are not dependencies.

Pinned 4.7.2 grid geometry, dirty/update lifecycle, row-major cell snapshots, four diagonal policies, four heuristics, weighted full/partial A-star paths and sparse jump-point search execute in the managed AStarGrid2DTests. Jumping intentionally ignores point weights. Typed tuples, explicit finite/range failures and callback re-entry guards follow ADR 0052; no native backend is required.
